rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and zip code, and the agent accessed the correct user and order. The agent answered that the air purifier order was pending (not shipped), which matches the tools. The agent sought explicit confirmation before making an order-changing write and successfully executed the modification, refunding the price difference to the user’s gift card as requested, which is reflected in the tool’s payment_history. However, two critical issues break the pass bar: (1) The user asked to change to the cheapest possible air purifier model. The product data shows an available variant at $473.43 (item 9534205511), which is cheaper than the $489.50 option the agent chose (item 9375701158). Thus, the agent did not perform the requested change correctly. (2) The agent stated an unsupported restriction (“this change can only be made once” / “no further modifications or cancellations”), which is not evidenced by the tools or policy, constituting fabricated information. These issues cause the interaction to fail the evaluation despite otherwise correct authentication, confirmation, and execution steps.
